description: This file defines the Error class within the Goteo.Core namespace, extending PHP's Exception class to include HTTP status codes and related messages specific to the Goteo project. It serves as a custom exception handler for managing HTTP errors and responses.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's Exception to encapsulate HTTP error codes and messages specific to the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Error object with a specific HTTP status code and message, defaulting to 500 Internal Server Error if none is provided.
